account.newKeyFailed: The new code wasn’t created. The old one still works.
account.protectFailed: Your messages couldn’t be protected. Try again — the keys to your old messages are still where they were.
account.restoreFailed: That code didn’t fit. Check you copied all of it, spaces and all.
account.staleCodeFailed: The code is put together correctly — and still does not fit this account. That happens when a recovery code has been created again: the previous one stops working for good.
account.startOverFailed: Couldn’t start again. Try again — for now, everything is as it was.
app.name: Iskra
elsewhere.message: Iskra can only run in one window at a time — otherwise its encryption keys get tangled. Switch to that window, or open Iskra here and it will close there.
elsewhere.title: Iskra is already open in another window
encryption.saveKeyHelp: We show it once and never again. Write it down or put it in a password manager: without it, your old messages don’t come back.
hotkey.editLast: In an empty message box, edit your last message
hotkey.escape: Close what’s on top; in a chat, go to the newest and mark it read
hotkeys.title: Keyboard shortcuts
message.media.tampered: This file doesn’t match what was sent, so it won’t be shown.
message.menu.deleteConfirmMessage: It’ll disappear for everyone in the chat, and it can’t be brought back.
message.unreadable: This message was sent before you joined, so it can’t be shown.
message.unsupported: Iskra can’t show this message yet.
poll.resultsHidden: Results will show when the poll ends
problem.title: It didn’t work
quickSwitch.label: Go to chat
recovery.approve.message: The reset has to be approved on your server’s page. If you did that, carry on — and your old messages are gone for good. If you changed your mind, nothing happens.
recovery.approve.title: Did you approve it?
recovery.choose.message: Your earlier messages are encrypted, and this device can’t open them yet. There are two ways — both of them work.
recovery.choose.title: Unlock your messages
recovery.creating.message: We’re putting your messages into a backup so you can read them from any device. This can take a minute.
recovery.creating.title: Setting up your backup
recovery.enter.message: The code we showed you when the backup was turned on.
recovery.enter.title: Enter your recovery code
recovery.lost.alone.message: Without the code and without another device, your old messages can’t come back — they stay encrypted for good. New messages will arrive as usual, and we’ll give you a new recovery code.
recovery.lost.alone.notPassword: Your account password has nothing to do with this: it opens your account, not your old messages.
recovery.lost.alone.title: Let’s start fresh
recovery.lost.hasDevices: That’s all right. Confirm this device from a phone or computer where you’re already signed in, and we’ll give you a new code to replace the lost one.
recovery.lost.noAccess: I can’t get to that device
recovery.lost.title: Can’t find it?
recovery.new.keepOld: Later — I’ll go and look for the old one
recovery.new.message: The old code stops working immediately, and there is no getting it back. If you have it written down somewhere, that copy becomes useless.
recovery.new.title: Create a new code?
recovery.password.message: Your server is asking you to confirm it’s really you.
recovery.password.title: Enter your password
recovery.preparing: One moment, looking through your messages
recovery.save.confirm: I’ve written the code down somewhere safe
recovery.save.warning: If this code is lost and you have no other device, nobody can bring your old messages back — not us, not the server. They stay encrypted for good.
room.emptyMessage: Send the first message — that’s how it starts.
room.loadFailedMessage: The messages haven’t gone anywhere — we just couldn’t load them. Check your connection.
room.noRoomSelectedMessage: Choose a conversation to start reading.
roomAction.acceptInviteFailed: You couldn’t join the chat. The invitation may have been withdrawn.
roomAction.declineInviteFailed: The invitation wasn’t declined. It is still there — try again.
roomEvent.encryptionEnabled: From now on, only people in this chat can read these messages
roomEvent.roomPictureChanged: The chat has a new picture
roomList.archive.title: Archive
roomList.emptyMessage: When someone messages you, it’ll show up here.
roomList.title: Chats
sendFailure.identityChanged: Someone in this chat signed in somewhere new, so their identity changed. Check it’s really them, and this message will go.
sendFailure.insecureDevices: Someone here is signed in on a device you haven’t verified yet. Verify it, and this message will go.
sendFailure.server: Your server turned this message away.
sendFailure.verificationRequired: Verify this device before sending to a private chat. Open Settings to do it.
session.ended.message: Your server has stopped accepting this session. You most likely ended it from another device. Sign in again — none of your conversations have gone anywhere.
session.ended.title: You are no longer signed in
session.offlineMessage: Your conversations are here, on this device. We just can’t reach the server right now — check your network.
signIn.problem.badCredentials: That username or password didn’t work. Try again.
signIn.problem.notFound: We couldn’t find an account service at that address. Check the spelling and try again.
signIn.problem.ssoIncomplete: That sign-in didn’t complete. Give it another go.
signIn.problem.storageUnavailable: Iskra couldn’t set up secure storage on this device, so it can’t sign you in safely.
signIn.problem.unreachable: Something went wrong reaching that address. Check your connection and try again.
signIn.problem.unsupportedMethod: That service uses a way of signing in that Iskra doesn’t support yet.
signIn.readyHelp: We’ll open your server’s page so you can sign in the usual way.
signIn.title: Welcome to Iskra
signIn.usePasswordInstead: I only have a username and password
signIn.whereIsAccountHelp: If someone gave you an address to use, type it here. If not, matrix.org works for most people.
signOut.confirmMessage: Your conversations and encryption keys will be removed from this device. You’ll need your recovery key to read older messages here again.
storage.dock.message: Safari erases data for sites you haven’t opened in a week — encryption keys included. It leaves apps in the Dock alone: File → Add to Dock.
storage.dock.title: Add Iskra to the Dock so Safari doesn’t erase it
storage.persist.message: When your disk runs low, Firefox may erase Iskra’s data — encryption keys included. It’s about to ask whether Iskra can keep them safely.
storage.persist.title: Keep your conversations safe?
timeline.deleteFailed: The message couldn’t be deleted, so it’s still there. Try again.
timeline.editFailed: The change wasn’t saved, so the message still says what it did. Try again.
timeline.pinFailed: The pinned messages couldn’t be changed. You may not be allowed to.
timeline.reactionFailed: Your reaction didn’t go through. Try again.
timeline.voteFailed: Your vote didn’t count. Try again.
upload.tooLarge: “{name}” is larger than the server accepts ({limit}).
verification.asked.message: This device has just signed in to your account and is asking you to verify it. If that was you, agree — and then compare the emoji. If it wasn't, refuse: somebody else knows your password.
verification.compare: Your other device is showing the same seven emoji. Check that they match — and that they are in the same order.
verification.declined.message: If the emoji really did not match, do not trust this connection, and try again. It may also be that you simply started the verification twice.
verification.declined.title: Verification stopped
verification.done.message: Your account trusts this device now. Your older conversations will appear here on their own.
verification.done.title: This device is verified
verification.failed.message: The verification did not finish. Try again.
verification.failed.title: That didn't work
verification.negotiating.message: The two devices are working it out between them. The emoji are about to appear on both screens.
verification.negotiating.title: One moment
verification.refused.message: That device was given no access to your conversations. But if the sign-in wasn't yours, then somebody else knows your password — and it needs changing right now.
verification.refused.title: You said no
verification.signIn.title: Account sign-in
verification.title: Verification
verification.waiting.message: The app on your other device has to be open right now, or the request will not reach it.
verification.waiting.title: Look at your other device
